title: AMBA LTI translation unit: translation requests (LA) answered in order on LR with context tags from a programmed table, completions (LC), link open / close with request credits, invalidation with synchronization

regs.name: TBL
regs.desc: Translation table entry; writing TBL2 writes entry cfg_idx

fdesc.cfg_ssidv: set: the entry is for SubstreamID cfg_ssid only; clear: for any substream

regs.name: INV
regs.desc: Invalidation; writing INV clears every entry (inv_all) or the entries of StreamID inv_sid. The core takes it once the one before has synchronized

fields.desc: context tags handed out on LR and not yet returned on LC

irqs.name: FAULT
irqs.desc: a translation or permission fault was returned on LR

irqs.name: PROTO
irqs.desc: a request without a credit (dropped) or a context tag returned that was not out

irqs.name: SYNC
irqs.desc: an invalidation has synchronized: every tag out when it was taken has come back

notes: lm_open_*, la_*, lr_* and lc_* are the LTI link, request, response and completion channels to the manager; they pass through unchanged.
The core parameters NE (8), RQ (4) and NCT (8) keep their defaults.
